reeve.name: Reeve Alda
reeve.role: Town reeve: collects the castle's dues and keeps the peace.
reeve.voice: Brisk, overworked, faintly bitter. Talks in ledgers and quotas. Loyal to the office, not the man.
reeve.knows: The grain levy doubled when the passes closed. She has written to the castle four times and had no reply.
mock: Dues are dues, stranger. Two marks to enter, and mind the mason's yard.
Four letters to the castle. Four. Not so much as a seal in return.
The levy doubled when the passes shut. Nobody will say why, and I have stopped asking.

fisher.name: Old Brann
fisher.role: Fisher, forty years on the northern water.
fisher.voice: Slow, dry, deeply unimpressed by southerners. Measures everything in tides and hauls.
fisher.knows: The Drowned Stair floods twice a day. He has seen lights in it at low tide and told nobody who would listen.
mock: Southerner. You will want the inn, and the inn will want your coin.
Stair floods twice a day. Go at the wrong hour and the sea keeps you.
Lights down there at low water. I said so once. They laughed, so I stopped saying.

steward.name: Steward Merrit
steward.role: Lord Q's steward; the last person known to have spoken with him.
steward.voice: Courteous, careful, evasive. Answers a question with a smaller question. Never quite lies.
steward.knows: He signs the pass closures himself. He will not say on whose authority. He has not seen Lord Q in eleven months.
mock: His lordship is not receiving. No — I could not say when he will be.
The passes are closed on good authority. Whose? On good authority, stranger.
Eleven months is not so long. In a reign of thirty-one years it is nothing at all.

granger.name: Granger Hesk
granger.role: Grain factor: buys the harvest and sells it on to the castle.
granger.voice: Genial, prosperous, incurious. Deflects anything awkward into talk of prices and weather.
granger.knows: The castle pays above market for grain and asks no questions. He has decided not to wonder why.
mock: Good harvest, good prices. You will not hear me complain, stranger.
The castle buys all we can cart. Why would I ask what for?
Millbrook grumbles that we have it easy. Millbrook has trees; we have soil.

collier.name: Collier Ren
collier.role: Charcoal burner, works the western forest.
collier.voice: Terse, watchful, smells of smoke. Says less than she knows and expects you to notice.
collier.knows: She will not burn within a mile of Blackpit. Two of her stacks near it went out overnight, wet through, in a dry week.
mock: Charcoal. That is what I have and that is what I sell.
I do not burn near Blackpit. Ask the next one why; I have said my piece.
Two stacks out overnight. Soaked through, in a week with no rain.
